Studying game design at Brassart, my curiosity has always pushed me forward. Nintendo shaped my vision of gameplay, cinema my sensitivity for staging and direction, and from that double influence was born my childhood dream: to create things myself. Today, I code, design, draw, and compose on my own projects, and I'm looking for a team where I can keep learning, to feed that curiosity and that drive to create.

My passions
Movies

Movies

Having grown up in the birthplace of cinema, Lyon, I've been a film lover since childhood. I watch movies almost every day, often at the theater. From directing to screenwriting, I'm passionate about this art form that has shaped my whole life. It's probably my favorite art, the one that moves me most.

Video games

Video games

Ever since I discovered The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, video games have been a passion that's never let go of me. Whether solo or multiplayer, ludological or narratological, I love video games for every type of experience they have to offer. I'm just as amazed by a game with elegant, innovative game design like Breath of the Wild or Öoo as I am by experiences built around staging and narrative design unique to the medium, like Outer Wilds or Alan Wake II.

Music

Music

After seven years of guitar, I moved to the computer, which let me truly grow as a musician. I compose for fun: music and sound design for my games, tracks just for myself, sometimes for friends' projects. Daft Punk and Ludwig Göransson are, I think, the artists who've influenced me most, and my favorite genres are electronic music, film and video game scores, and rap.

Climbing

Climbing

I spent a long time looking for the sport that would truly click with me, before discovering bouldering. I love the freedom and the instant, almost die-and-retry feel of this sport. Like a puzzle, each route is a problem to solve, not unlike game design.

Photography

Photography

My passion for photography stems from my passion for cinema. What I find fascinating is trying to find the most aesthetic frame for each situation while still telling a story, even if, at my level, I'm obviously far from being a photographer. I find it truly exciting to capture moments in a single frame, one photo that, for me, will bring back entire memories of a trip or a period of my life.
